name: pi-agents
description: Delegate bounded work through durable Pi tasks and verify evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate, monitor, and verify Pi work
interface.longDescription: Delegate bounded work to local Pi Durable workers. Monitor progress, approve scoped effects, recover exact executions, inspect immutable evidence, and record parent review. Includes the runtime and provider dependencies; requires Node.js 24.15+ within 24.x and a configured model route.
defaultPrompt: Use $pi-agents:pi-agents to prepare a bounded task, monitor it, and verify the deliverable.
